1.Nf3 c5 2.c4 Nc6 3.g3 g6 4.Bg2 Bg7 5.O-.strategy: Brings the knight out and puts pressure on d5, which Black's e-pawn already guards. White's c4 pawn restricts Black's d-pawn, so Black has to find the right moment to open the centre; the game is balanced.
